scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:screens
scripts.test:unit: esbuild test/parse.test.ts test/protocol.test.ts test/settings.test.ts test/limbs.test.ts test/api.test.ts test/cutout.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=node_modules/.cache/tests --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=error && node node_modules/.cache/tests/parse.test.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/tests/protocol.test.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/tests/settings.test.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/tests/limbs.test.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/tests/api.test.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/tests/cutout.test.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && partykit deploy --serve dist
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && partykit deploy --serve dist --preview staging
scripts.dev:cutout: test -x .venv-cutout/bin/python && .venv-cutout/bin/python scripts/cutout-server.py 8788 || echo "[cutout] not installed — run: npm run setup:cutout (photos will use the in-browser cutout until then)"
